name: sudoku
title: Sudoku
description: Sudoku made on your machine: a daily puzzle in Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert (the same for everyone that day) and a new one whenever you like, graded by the techniques it takes. Notes without switching modes, auto notes, hints that explain in plain words, and every move saved.
author: pal

settings.label: Opens on
settings.description: Whose daily the first open shows when nothing is left half-done. ⌘N picks any difficulty either way.

settings.label: Checking
settings.description: Clashes are the same digit twice in a row, column or box. Mistakes also mark a digit that is not the answer, and count them. Also on ⌘K.

options.title: Show mistakes as you make them

settings.label: Clock
settings.text: Show the time while you play
settings.description: Off hides the running time. Your times still count for stats and show when you finish. Also T or ⌘K in the game.

settings.label: Auto notes
settings.text: Keep every empty cell's notes filled in for me
settings.description: Each empty cell shows the digits that still fit, updated as you play; you only take out the ones you rule out, and they stay out. Off brings your own notes back. Also C or ⌘K in the game.

store.tagline: Daily sudoku in four difficulties, with notes and hints that explain
features: A daily puzzle per difficulty, the same on every machine, and a new one any time with `cmd+n`; nothing is fetched
Graded by the techniques it needs, from singles you can spot to X-wings and swordfish
Notes without an extra step: type a second digit into a cell and it keeps both as notes; auto notes on `c`
Hints in three steps: where to look, why in plain words, then the move
A digit-first mode on `d`, undo and redo, and clashes or mistakes marked as you play
A clock you can hide, streaks, best and average times per difficulty, and every past daily by month
Clean solves go on leaderboards, the fastest per difficulty and each daily's own; signed in to a pal account, the stats and streaks follow you to every machine

screenshots.caption: Today's medium, half solved: the digit in focus and its notes lit across the board, the pad's bars
A hint: where to look first, then why, and the move on Enter
Solved: the time, the streak, Flawless, and today's next daily on Enter
⌘N: today's puzzle or a new one, per difficulty
Stats per difficulty: the best, the average, the streak and every solve

actions.title: Hint
actions.description: Where to look; again for why; again for the move.

actions.title: Notes mode
actions.description: Digits write notes instead. Shift with a digit writes one without switching, and a second digit over a placed one makes notes anyway.

actions.title: Auto notes
actions.description: Every empty cell shows what still fits; you only take notes out. Again to bring your own back.

actions.title: Digit first
actions.description: Pick a digit, then click the cells it goes in. Again to leave.

actions.title: Fill in notes
actions.description: Every empty cell gets what fits; notes you wrote are only trimmed. Shift-A clears them.

actions.title: New game
actions.description: Today's puzzle or a new one, per difficulty.

actions.title: Browse
actions.description: The dailies by month, and every half-done game.

actions.title: Stats
actions.description: Times, streaks and the history per difficulty.

actions.title: Pause
actions.description: Stops the clock and hides the board.

actions.title: Hide the clock
actions.description: No running time on screen; again to bring it back. Times still count.

sudoku.title: Sudoku
sudoku.description: The game left half-done, else today's daily. Escape leaves at any point; every move is saved.

keys.title: Place a digit (1 to 9); a different one over it makes notes
A note (shift or alt with a digit)
Digit first: pick a digit, click cells
